summary: Tested mobile-first Expo/React Native domino calculator app. Home screen, navigation, target selector, custom target, name inputs, back button, and persistence-load all work. CRITICAL BLOCKER: adding a score (the core feature of the app) is completely broken — typing a number in p1-score-input/p2-score-input updates the React controlled-state correctly (verified value: '77' in React fiber), but tapping p1-add-button / p2-add-button does NOT add the score: total stays 0, no score item is rendered, and the input is not cleared. Direct invocation of the React onClick prop on the add-button also fails to produce any state change. Because scores cannot be added, the delete, reset, winner-modal, and new-round flows are also untestable end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping the '+' add button does NOT add the typed score to the list. p1-total / p2-total stay at 0, no [pX-score-item-N] element is rendered, and the score input is NOT cleared after press. Reproduced consistently with: (a) page.fill, (b) page.keyboard.type, (c) React's native-value-setter + input event, (d) mouse.down/up at button center, and (e) direct invocation of the React onClick prop on the add button. In each case the score input's React fiber confirms `value: '77'` (state IS updated by typing), so the bug lies in the addScore flow itself — addScore is either returning early or its setState calls are being dropped. Because addScore holds an early-return on `winnerName`, but winnerName is null on a freshly cleared session, it should not bail. Recommend adding console.log inside addScore to confirm whether it is actually entered and which branch returns. Also verify there is no shadowing/stale-closure issue with the parent's input1/input2 vs PlayerColumn's local `input` prop.

On a 414x900 viewport the addRow (score input + add button) is rendered slightly outside the player column's clip area, causing Playwright to report 'Element is outside of the viewport' for p2-add-button until forced. The score input also visually overflows to the left edge of the screen. Consider reducing TextInput min width / padding inside the two-column split so the +button stays fully inside the column on narrow widths.

Could not verify the reset confirmation flow because the score-add bug blocks reaching a state with scores to reset. Alert.alert in RN-Web normally renders as a native window.confirm; ensure it is wired so the destructive action clears scores but keeps names + target.

integration_issues.flow: Add score -> total updates -> winner modal -> new round
integration_issues.issue: Entire scoring pipeline is blocked by the add-button bug. Winner-modal (testID='winner-modal') and new-round (testID='new-round-button') therefore could not be reached via UI.

issues: Score input + add button row overflows the player column on small viewports (≤414px wide). Tighten gap and TextInput padding.
Add button (44x44) meets minimum touch target — OK.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo dependency check warns: installed @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 but expected 2.2.0 for the current Expo SDK. Although AsyncStorage.getItem on first load works (hydration completes), version mismatch can cause subtle issues. Recommend `yarn add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@2.2.0` (or the version `npx expo install` resolves).
Console warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Coming from a dependency, low priority.

Also try removing the persist useEffect temporarily to see whether something inside it (e.g., AsyncStorage.setItem failure with v3.0.2) is throwing and aborting the render.

critical_code_review_comments: domino.tsx: addScore reads input1/input2 from the parent's closure; consider lifting `input` into PlayerColumn or pass an explicit `value` arg to addScore to eliminate any chance of stale closures.
domino.tsx winner useEffect: the chained if/else branches are partly redundant (lines 87-95). Simplify to a single comparison: if (total1 >= target || total2 >= target) pick the larger.
Files are within size guidance (<700 lines) — good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The score-adding bug is the single blocker. Public URL https://mobile-game-design-3.preview.emergentagent.com works; route /games/domino loads. Use viewport 414x900 or 375x667. Note: page.fill on RN-Web TextInput does not always update React state — prefer page.click + page.keyboard.type, or use Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set + dispatchEvent('input',{bubbles:true}). After main agent fixes addScore, re-run the full E2E from this report.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction (deterministic): 1) Open /games/domino. 2) Clear localStorage and reload. 3) Click p1-score-input, type '77'. 4) Click p1-add-button. Expected: p1-total='77', p1-score-item-0 visible, input cleared. Actual: p1-total='0', no score item, input still '77'. React fiber on the input confirms props.value='77' (state is correct). React fiber on the add button confirms onClick is bound. Even calling that onClick directly via JS (`props.onClick({})`) produces no state change. Therefore the bug is inside addScore — most likely an early-return that should not be hit (the `raw === ''` or `isNaN` checks against a stale closure of input1) OR a thrown error inside the surrounding effect that prevents commit. Mitigation: instrument addScore with console.log and re-test.
